user-guide.title: User Guide
user-guide.subtitle: Your step-by-step guide to operating the system

setup.title: System Setup
setup.description: Begin by navigating to the Settings page. This is your starting point to configure the entire system. Complete each tab in order to get your organization up and running.

subscription.title: Subscription & Company
subscription.description: Activate your subscription plan to unlock system features. Then configure your company profile with essential details like tax ID, phone number, domain, logo, and official stamp.

system-data.title: Data Imports
system-data.description: Import your organization's data including employees, chart of accounts, items, and other essential records. The import wizard guides you through uploading spreadsheets and mapping fields.

roles-users.title: Roles & Users
roles-users.description: Define roles with specific permissions to control access across modules. Then create user accounts and assign them appropriate roles to ensure secure, role-based access.

systems.title: Systems Overview
systems.description: The application is organized into six integrated systems, each serving a distinct business function. Enable the systems you need from your subscription settings.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.desc: Define strategic objectives, KPIs, and business plans

operation.title: Operation
operation.desc: Manage HR, departments, leaves, and regulatory compliance

production.title: Production
production.desc: Handle manufacturing, garage operations, and POS channels

finance.title: Finance
finance.desc: Accounting, banking, assets, and financial reporting

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: Drive innovation processes from ideation to commercialization

support.title: Support
support.desc: Sales, marketing, CRM, logistics, and inventory management

portal.title: Portal Page
portal.description: The Portal is your centralized dashboard. View in-progress tasks, overdue items, upcoming events, department stats, and quick notes — all in one place. Use the search bar to find anything across the system.

kpi-import.title: KPI Import from Strategy
kpi-import.description: KPIs are defined in the Strategy module's Strategic Framework. Once configured, they automatically flow into performance dashboards across all systems, providing real-time tracking of your strategic goals.

dashboards.title: Performance Dashboards
dashboards.description: Each system has a dedicated performance dashboard displaying key metrics and charts. Dashboards pull KPI data from the Strategy module to show progress, trends, and areas needing attention.

finance.title: Finance for Accountants
finance.description: The Finance module provides a complete accounting suite. Manage your Chart of Accounts, record Journal Entries, track Banking transactions, manage Assets, handle Financing, and generate comprehensive financial Reports.

support-inventory.title: Support & Inventory
support-inventory.description: Use the Support module to create and manage items, monitor inventory levels, track stock movements, and manage suppliers. Set reorder points to receive alerts when stock runs low.

tasks-jobs-projects.title: Tasks, Jobs & Projects
tasks-jobs-projects.description: These are the main driving actions in the system. Tasks are individual work items, Jobs group related tasks with deadlines, and Projects organize multiple jobs into larger initiatives. They power workflow across all modules.

task.title: Tasks
task.desc: Individual actionable work items assigned to team members

job.title: Jobs
job.desc: Groups of related tasks with timelines and milestones

project.title: Projects
project.desc: Large initiatives combining multiple jobs and resources
